narrative.intro: Battelle Memorial Institute has $1.2B in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Battelle Memorial Institute received 1 award so far this fiscal year, and the average award size is $1.2B. Obligations are down 25.9% year over year. Historical obligations show that Battelle Memorial Institute peaked at $1.6B in FY23, FY24, and FY25, after rising from $1.3B in FY21 and $1.5B in FY22. The current-year totals are partial because the fiscal year is still in progress, and the report mixes obligation figures with award-value figures for some tables. The concentration of FY2026 obligations into a single large award makes the current-year profile lumpy compared with prior years when obligations were steadier at $1.6B. Contract managers and capture teams should interpret the $1.2B figure as a snapshot that can change as the fiscal year progresses. Budget officers and program managers evaluating Battelle Memorial Institute should use the multi-year series for context rather than relying solely on the FY2026 to date total.
